vectors.title: A death event a stored person points at as its birth gets a full date: refused
The same full date on a death event no person points at as a birth is kept
A person's birth_ref_index now targets a stored event that carries a full date: the stored event is refused
A birth_ref_index moved off an event frees that event's date in the same batch
An event retyped to Birth keeps its full date: refused
A custom event type that matches the birth pattern is birth-like
A citation of a stored birth event gets a full date: refused
A full date on a citation of a death event is kept
Retyping an event to Birth makes its stored citation's full date a violation on the citation
A citation added to an EventRef of a birth-like event is checked
The same for a Family's EventRef to a Baptism
A Birth-type alternate name with a day or month is refused; another name type is not
An event that names a stored Street place must be re-pointed
Deleting the person that points at an event frees its date
Birth-like text must be a bare year
A new person and a new event in one batch: the birth_ref makes the event birth-like
A stored person that the batch rewrites no longer counts: the batch's version decides
A TEXTONLY date on a birth-like event is refused on its modifier
A full date on a death event is kept in a tree that has an unrelated birth
